name: Kruger National Park
blurb: Travelers and photographers share wildlife sightings and safari experiences from Kruger National Park in South Africa. Recent posts highlight the park's centenary celebration, conservation efforts, and diverse animal species observed during game drives.

positive: Amazing and memorable multi-day safari experiences
Close encounters with diverse wildlife and endangered species
negative: Disappointment regarding Gen-AI artwork used for the centenary celebration
Malaria medication requirements acting as a deterrent for some visitors
Concerns regarding microplastics in river creatures and elephant management policies

quotes.text: It’s a real shame that the centenary of the crown jewel of South Africa’s nature reserves, The Kruger National Park, should be celebrated with Gen-AI slop artwork.

This was a big surprise for us during our visit to Kruger National Park: wild dog puppies right next to the road! It was only the second time I’d seen this endangered species in Kruger, and to see the next generation up close like this was a real treat.
Sunsets are pure magic in Kruger National Park, especially when you’re sitting at the aptly named Sunset Dam. #travel

What a beauty.. I almost signed up to go to Kruger National Park, but at the time you had to take malaria tablets.. I said no..Went on several train trips in South Africa instead.. It's worth a visit... cheers
